subpages.title: About ScaleIL
subpages.desc: Who ScaleIL is, how we work, and the team behind it.
h: We close the gap between global technology and Israeli programmes.
subpages.text: Skip to main content Menu Home Solutions Partners Services About Contact About Trust first, technology second. We believe personal relationships and straight technical answers are what actually move a project forward. Our aim is to be the adviser you call before you have decided what to buy — not after. What we do We close the gap between global technology and Israeli programmes. Founded in 2015, ScaleIL has spent more than a decade representing the vendors behind avionics, vehicle platforms, medical devices and national infrastructure — and making them practical to buy and deploy in Israel: local quoting and licensing, first-line support in your time zone, and engineers who can sit in your lab. We continuously work to understand our customers’ needs and challenges so we can offer the right technology and the know-how to apply it — and we leverage our understanding of the Israeli market to represent our partners’ technology properly here. Our engineering team is qualified to the highest industry standards and professionally accredited by the leading hardware and software vendors we carry. Management Meet the team Chief Executive Officer Tomer Bogin Tomer brings more than twenty years across embedded and enterprise technology, on both the engineering and commercial sides. Before founding ScaleIL he was Wind River's Sales Director for the Middle East, covering aerospace, defense and homeland security programmes, and served as COO of NextNine, where he defined and executed the company's industrial IoT strategy. Earlier he spent over a decade at Mercury Interactive — later acquired by HP — managing part of the Americas presales organisation and then heading technical field operations across Asia Pacific. He holds a BA in computer science from Tel Aviv University and an MBA

ScaleIL represents vendors whose technology carries real consequences — aircraft, vehicles, medical devices, national infrastructure. No single one of them builds a whole system. Each entry below explains what that piece actually does, and links straight to the vendor. Operating systems, storage & edge The foundation layer: what runs on the metal, how it boots, how it updates and how it keeps data intact. RTOS · Linux · Virtualization · Edge cloud Wind River VxWorks is the RTOS behind Mars landers and commercial avionics: deterministic scheduling, ARINC 653 time and space partitioning, and DO-178C certification evidence up to DAL A. Wind River Linux is a Yocto Project–based distribution with CVE tracking and long-term maintenance. Helix Virtualization Platform adds a Type 1 hypervisor that runs unmodified guest operating systems side by side, so certified and non-certified workloads share one multi-core SoC instead of separate boxes. VxWorks Wind River Linux Helix Platform Studio Visit Wind River Ubuntu · Kubernetes · OpenStack Canonical / Ubuntu Ubuntu Pro extends security maintenance to ten years across the main and universe archives, with FIPS 140 validated crypto modules, CIS and DISA-STIG hardening profiles and kernel livepatching that closes vulnerabilities without a reboot. For infrastructure, MicroK8s and Charmed Kubernetes cover edge clusters and Charmed OpenStack covers private cloud. Ubuntu Core delivers a transactional, fully containerised OS for devices, with secure boot and full-disk encryption. subpages.title: Professional services — ScaleIL
subpages.desc: System design, certification support, code review, training and licensing.
h: A licence is not a solution.
From first conversation to working system.
subpages.text: Skip to main content Menu Home Solutions Partners Services About Contact Professional services A licence is not a solution. Our engineering team is accredited by the vendors we represent and has built the kind of systems you are building. We work alongside your team from design through to a system that meets its timing, safety and security requirements. System design Architecture reviews and technology selection before commitments harden: partitioning strategy, OS and hypervisor choice, board and silicon fit, and the certification basis that follows from them. Certification support Mapping DO-178C, ISO 26262, IEC 61508, IEC 62304 and EU CRA objectives onto tools and evidence, so the artefact list is settled early rather than discovered during an audit. Code review & optimization Targeted review of real-time behaviour, memory footprint, boot time and interrupt latency, with measurement on the actual hardware rather than estimates. Technical training Hands-on vendor-accredited training on VxWorks, Wind River Linux, RedHawk, TASKING toolchains and the Rapita Verification Suite, delivered on site in Hebrew or English. On-site consulting Engineers embedded in your team through integration and bring-up, from first board power-on to a system that meets its timing and safety requirements. Licensing & procurement Local quoting, licence management, renewals and export documentation — handled in-country, in your currency, on your purchasing process. How an engagement usually runs From first conversation to working system. Step 01 Technical discovery Your requirements, target silicon, certification basis and schedule — and what already exists.
